GeneDef.label: Samhain
GeneDef.description: Small in stature and possessing a child-like frame, the Samhain xenotype hides their faces behind mysterious masks while harbouring a dark propensity for combat with blades over firearms. Driven by an insatiable sweet tooth, these secretive humanoids possess an intense fondness for chocolate, often seeking it out as a rare comfort amid the rim's harsh realities.

GeneDef.label: psychopath
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene exhibit a lack of empathy and remorse, often displaying manipulative and antisocial behavior. They are driven by self-interest and show little regard for the well-being of others.

GeneDef.label: brawler
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are naturally inclined towards close-combat situations, showing a preference for physical confrontation over ranged weapons. They possess enhanced strength and resilience in hand-to-hand combat.

GeneDef.label: costumed
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene feel an intense psychological need to conceal their faces, deriving comfort and confidence from wearing headwear, masks, or full-face coverings. Uncovering their faces leaves them deeply unsettled.

GeneDef.label: sweet tooth
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene possess a hyper-specialized metabolic craving for highly processed sugars, deriving immense satisfaction and mood boosts from consuming chocolate and other sweets. While they suffer no physical harm from a standard diet, denying their persistent sugar cravings leaves them irritable and prone to minor mental breaks.
